jobs.title: Rekrutmen BRILiaN Internship Program (BIP) Frontliner
jobs.description: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk adalah salah satu bank milik pemerintah yang terbesar di Indonesia. Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) didirikan di Purwokerto, Jawa Tengah oleh Raden Bei Aria Wirjaatmadja tanggal 16 Desember 1895. Bank BRI memiliki layanan perbankan sampai seluruh penjuru Indonesia dan cukup terkenal oleh masyarakat Indonesia. Berikut ini adalah BRILiaN Banking Associate Program (BBAP). Berpengalaman lebih dari 120 tahun, Bank BRI senantiasa memberikan kemudahan dan kecepatan dalam merespon berbagai kebutuhan nasabah. Dengan didukung oleh layanan perbankan yang prima, jutaan transaksi nasabah dikelola selama 24 jam sehari 7 hari seminggu melalui fasilitas layanan yang tersebar secara luas di seantero negeri. Dalam menjalankan aktivitas operasional, Bank BRI berpedoman pada visi dan misi yang membantu Perusahaan untuk tetap fokus dalam meraih pencapaian keberhasilan. Visi dan misi ini membantu Bank BRI untuk selalu berupaya mencapai idealisme dengan mengingatkan manajemen serta karyawan bahwa mereka bekerja sama demi tujuan-tujuan yang sama, yang akan menjadi sumbangan dalam keberhasilan jangka panjang Perusahaan. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk Saat ini Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI) memberikan kesempatan lowongan kerja untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: BRILiaN Internship Program (BIP) Frontliner Wilayah Penempatan : BRI Branch Office Madiun Kualifikasi Pria Pendidikan Minimal D3/S1 semua jurusan dengan IPK min. 3.00 Fresh Graduate dipersilahkan untuk mendaftar Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik Bersedia ditugaskan diseluruh Wilayah Kerja BRI BO Madiun Tata Cara Melamar: Kirim Lamaran Lengkap ke : BRI BO Madiun Jl. Pahlawan No.50, Pangongangan, Kec. Manguharjo, Kota Madiun, Jawa Timur 63122 Batas Pendaftaran 13 November 2026 Hati-hati terhadap segala bentuk jenis penipuan, karena lowongan ini gratis tidak ada biaya dalam bentuk apapun.

A Typical Day:  Perform investigations of security incidents using your knowledge of digital forensics and data analytics. Use your coding, data analytics and investigation skills to hunt, detect and respond to threats. jobs.description: Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue. We re building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us. Senior SRE - Networks Fastly’s Technical Operations (TechOps) team is responsible for building & operating the infrastructure that powers the Fastly Edge Cloud Platform. We oversee an extensive global network that spans 6 continents with over 100 points of presence and 578 Tbps of connected capacity.  Our platform serves a significant portion of the content delivered to internet consumers across the planet, with customers ranging from online media streaming services to e-commerce, to open source projects, nonprofits and more. We take this responsibility seriously! We’re looking for an experienced SRE with strong focus on Networks, SRE principals and knowledge of the internet who can bring engineering best practices, operational rigour, and automation skills to help craft the future of Fastly’s network and directly contribute to making the internet better. What You ll Do: Build, operate, and maintain the continually growing global network footprint of Fastly’s Edge Cloud Platform. Response to significant traffic incidents and lead network incidents, resolving edge cases and failure scenarios with your expertise in IP routing, particularly BGP. jobs.description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. jobs.title: Lead Solution Architect – D365 F&O Finance & SCM (f/m/x)

Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One +, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market. Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy. What you'll do Enpal is transforming its ERP landscape from a traditional D365 F&O setup into an Agentic Enterprise, a clean D365 core with an AI-native execution layer on top. AI-native product squads, organized by E2E process domain (D2O, O2C, P2P, SCE, R2R, MDG), replace traditional workstream towers. Each squad includes a Business Intent Owner (BIO), a Technology Orchestrator, Context Engineers, and Harness Engineers. This role sits in the Finance (R2R, O2C, MDG) squad and is a core contributor to building the agentic operating model that will power Enpal at scale. As A Lead Solution Architect , you own the Finance & SCM architecture across D365 F&O, defining how GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, and Project Accounting are structured, governed, and evolved across 30+ legal entities. You set the design standards that functional consultants, developers, and partners work within, lead the decisions that are hard to reverse, and ensure that the Finance platform is the trusted, auditable system of record that a complex, multi-entity enterprise demands. jobs.title: Partner Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als Partner Manager (m/w/d) bei Enpal Financial Solutions übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für ein eigenes Portfolio an Installateur-Partnern und entwickelst diese Partnerschaften aktiv weiter. Du bist nicht nur Ansprechpartner für unsere Partner, sondern Owner für deren Entwicklung und Erfolg . Du verstehst ihre Geschäftsmodelle und Vertriebsprozesse, analysierst ihre Performance und identifizierst konkrete Hebel, um Aktivierung, Nutzung und Abschlussraten zu steigern. Dabei kombinierst Du Beziehungsmanagement, analytisches Denken und eine ausgeprägte Sales-Mentalität . Du gehst proaktiv auf Deine Partner zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen, die einen messbaren Business Impact schaffen. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Operations und Product zusammen und bringst Deine Erkenntnisse aus dem Partnergeschäft aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von EFS ein. Dein Spielfeld Partner Management & Growth Du verantwortest ein eigenes Portfolio an Installateur-Partnern und entwickelst langfristige, erfolgreiche Partnerschaften. Du verstehst die Geschäftsmodelle und Vertriebsprozesse Deiner Partner und identifizierst Potenziale für Wachstum und Aktivierung. Du analysierst die Performance Deines Portfolios anhand relevanter KPIs und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Partner hinter ihren Möglichkeiten zurückbleiben, und entwickelst proaktiv Lösungen. Du gehst aktiv auf Partner zu und wartest nicht darauf, dass Herausforderungen oder Anfragen bei Dir landen. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern auf und kannst sowohl mit operativen Teams als auch mit Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren. Commercial & Analytical Ownership Du kombinierst Daten und Partner-Insights, um die Entwicklung Deines Portfolios zu verstehen. Du identifizierst Muster, Chancen und Risiken und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinen Partnern Maßnahme

jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager, UK
jobs.description: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager to lead our organisation and team in the UK as Market Lead and be the public face of Change.org in the country. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through deep networks across UK politics, civil society, civic tech, newsrooms, broadcasters, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle. We'd welcome ambitious and entrepreneurial Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role. Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions. What you will achieve Create awareness spikes . Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Turn those moments into measurable growth for Change.org in the UK, such as new petition starters, signers and supporters. At a Senior Manager level, own the UK team's goals and report on how campaigns contribute to Change.org 's wider growth targets. Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Coach them on strategy, find the route to victory, and help them build the pressure that gets decision makers to act.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Director
jobs.description: Customer Operations Director Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence? As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets. Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. What will you do? You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. You will: Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high

jobs.description: About Techtive Games Techtive Games is a Germany-based video game developer creating Ardem , an open-world survival game. Built by former modding veterans, the studio combines AA-level ambition with an independent mindset to push development practices forward and build immersive worlds built to be played, modified, and expanded. We're looking for an Environment Artist to join our team as we move into full production on our debut game Ardem, an open world survival game developed in Unreal Engine 5. In this role, your focus is asset production, with a strong emphasis on architecture and modularity. Our world artists build Ardem's world —> you create what they build it with: modular architecture kits, bespoke landmark structures, and the environmental assets that make the world feel believable and lived-in. You won't be doing level design yourself, but you need the instincts of someone who could — assets only work if they're made with world-building in mind. At Techtive, we believe in a creative workflow where everyone contributes to the final look and feel of the world. It's a team effort: you'll work closely with World Art, Tech Art, and 3D Art, using cutting-edge UE5 tech to push visuals to new heights. One thing we care about a lot: we're hiring from our community. We want people who actually play survival games — not as market research, but because it's your genre. If you know from hundreds of hours in the genre why a base location feels right, why a ruin tells a story, or why clutter placement can make or break immersion, you already understand half the job. jobs.description: Wollen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft in einem wegweisenden Projekt gestalten? Bei der Deutschen Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) in Düsseldorf erwartet Sie eine spannende Herausforderung. Im Auftrag des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie entwickelt und betreibt die Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) die vier schwimmenden LNG-Terminals an der deutschen Nordseeküste, über die LNG vom Schiff in das Gasnetz eingespeist wird. Die sogenannten Floating Storage and Regasification Units (FSRU) sind von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und damit kritische Infrastruktur mit hohem Risikopotenzial. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Verantwortungsbereichs teilhaben möchten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute und gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns! Aufgaben Ihre Aufgabe: Den Markt verstehen, weiterdenken und in Projekte übersetzen Genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel: Als Manager Business Development & Market Analysis (m/w/d) beobachten und analysieren Sie fortlaufend die Entwicklungen in den internationalen Energiemärkten – von LNG über Gas bis hin zu grünen Alternativen. Sie leiten daraus Empfehlungen für die Ausgestaltung unserer Marktangebote ab und entwickeln Tools zur systematischen Bewertung der Versorgungssicherheit in Deutschland. Sie entwickeln und leiten strategische Projekte zur Nutzung unsere Terminalstandorte. Aktuell begleiten sie beispielsweise eine europaweit ausgeschriebene Konzeptstudie, aus der konkrete Projekte hervorgehen sollen. jobs.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. jobs.title: Operative Leitung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen 80 - 100 %
jobs.description: Sie wollen nicht nur Zahlen verwalten, sondern mitdenken, gestalten und sich in eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe entwickeln? Die 2022 gegründete curadmin AG mit Sitz in Rotkreuz ist ein administratives Dienstleistungsunternehmen für Organisationen im ambulanten Gesundheitswesen. Im Zentrum stehen betriebswirtschaftliche Dienstleistungen, aktuell insbesondere für die Hauptkundin solicare AG. Wir sind beauftragt, eine ambitionierte Persönlichkeit als Operative Leitung mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen anzusprechen. In dieser vielseitigen Funktion bearbeiten Sie anspruchsvolle Finanzthemen, erstellen Reportings, Budgets und Forecasts und schaffen fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Geschäftsleitung und Verwaltungsrat. Sie koordinieren und entwickeln Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Finanz- und Lohnbuchhaltung, HR, ICT und Governance weiter. Je nach Erfahrung bearbeiten oder koordinieren Sie zusätzlich Marketing- und Salesaufgaben. Sie sorgen für effiziente Prozesse, klare Abstimmungen, eine hohe Dienstleistungsqualität und die bedarfsgerechte Auslastung des Teams. Sie denken Prozesse digital und automatisieren, wo es sinnvoll ist. Sie verfügen über einen Hochschulabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringen Erfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen, Controlling oder in der betriebswirtschaftlichen Beratung mit. Sie erfassen Zusammenhänge rasch, ziehen aus Zahlen die richtigen Schlüsse und vermitteln komplexe Inhalte verständlich. Erste Führungserfahrung ist von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Ihre Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und der Wille, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und etwas zu bewegen. Die Position bietet Ihnen die Chance, Ihre Stärken einzubringen, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und sich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Bei entsprechendem Leistungsausweis eröffnen sich weitere Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der Unternehmung. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung. Kontakt: Corinne

jobs.description: Teamwork makes the stream work.   Roku is changing how the world watches TV Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.     What does the team work on? Roku TV is where embedded systems, media experiences, and intelligent software come together at massive scale. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer, Pre-Training
jobs.description: Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer ( Pre-training ) to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state. As a pre-training research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda. We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions. jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As a Navigation Engineer within our Precise Navigation team, you will design and develop high-precision navigation and positioning solutions based on tightly-coupled IMU/GNSS filtering, improving localisation accuracy, integrity, and robustness to jamming and spoofing for our autonomous systems – from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with the Navigation and Radar teams, as well as software and Electronic Warfare (EW) teams, to deliver robust, resilient Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) and ensure overall performance, robustness and reliability. Responsibilities Navigation Architecture: Drive the architecture and implementation of navigation / PNT solutions for autonomous platforms. jobs.description: Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs. 🚀 Our Story Partly is building the infrastructure for anyone to repair anything. We believe everything built should be repairable, and we're building frontier AI to put repair knowledge to work, starting with the $2tn automotive market. Our model, Interpreter, is the first AI purpose-built to understand repair. Trained on 1M+ car models and 1B+ parts, it reads a repair job the way an estimator does, resolves damage into the exact purchasable part, and shows its reasoning with a confidence score. On real production jobs, an estimator working with Interpreter reaches 98.8% parts-list accuracy, against 92.1% with today's tools. jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is s

jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
jobs.description: What we're building Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future. Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI . One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available ( paper ). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact ( paper ) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise. Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright. This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy . Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute. The role You push the physics of Genesis-World forward.

Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal , and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it. We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA . We innovate across categories like accessories , swimwear , and sleepwear , and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this , this , and this . None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. jobs.title: Commercial Demand Planning Manager
jobs.description: The Commercial Demand Planning Manager is responsible for leading the short-range demand planning process and ensuring the organization operates with a highly accurate, execution-ready demand forecast. The role serves as the key link between Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain by translating market realities, trade inventory movements, customer demand signals, and commercial plans into a single aligned forecast. Job Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end short-range demand planning process by driving forecast alignment across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain, ensuring a single and accurate demand plan for execution. Analyze sales trends, market dynamics, customer movements, and commercial drivers to generate actionable insights, identify risks and opportunities, and improve forecasting accuracy. Develop, maintain, and continuously improve demand forecasting models through statistical analysis, performance monitoring, demand signal integration, and corrective action plans. Provide business planning and decision support through scenario modeling, forecast reviews, category planning, and recommendations that guide commercial and supply chain strategies. Drive forecast governance, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing planning tools, strengthening data quality, improving reporting capabilities, and championing best practices across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer - GPU Systems & Kernels
jobs.description: As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to make large-scale model training and inference as fast and efficient as the hardware allows. You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs. Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas: Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog s domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. What You ll Do: Write, tune, and debug GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for the operations that dominate LLM training and inference. Optimize for the latest NVIDIA GPU generations, including memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and low-precision formats such as FP8 and FP4 Reduce communication cost in distributed workloads (all-to-all, all-reduce) and overlap communication with compute across NVLink and across nodes Profile end-to-end training and rollout workloads to identify whether they are compute-, memory-, or communication-bound, and quantify the headroom Build benchmarks, profiling tools, and regression tests that guide optimization decisions Collaborate with Research Scientists to turn new model architectures into efficient implementations

Location sits at the heart of one of our current products, and privacy, trust and safety are part of how we build, not an afterthought. We're scaling fast, and this comes with legal implications. You'll draft, negotiate and advise yourself on the topics that matter most. We're not looking for someone who applies the rules by the book, but for someone who understands what we're building and why, and finds the legal approach that makes sense for it. Product and users first: you join discussions early and work with the team toward the same goal: making projects to life, fast and safe. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on. What you'll do Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence. Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it. Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims. You'll design the evals, observability and tooling that keep agent quality high in a regulated bank. ➡️ What you'll do Build agents: You'll develop agents that take real actions for customers. Match rigor to risk: You'll size evaluation to the stakes, because an agent making transfers is not a PR bot. Own evaluation of every feature: You'll make sure every new agent capability comes with the right evaluation strategy, defining what needs to be tested offline and validated online, based on business requirements, expected outcomes and risk. Observe agents in production: You'll build the monitoring strategy that makes agent behaviour visible, tracks performance against business objectives and flags issues early. Scale it as a platform: You'll turn our tools, evaluation practices and monitoring capabilities into a self-service platform that lets other teams build, evaluate and operate their own agents. ➡️ What we're looking for Evaluation mindset: You've evaluated models or LLM systems and know what makes a test misleading. Strong ML foundations: You understand the ML lifecycle, from training and iteration to evaluation and monitoring, and core concepts such as overfitting, generalization and cross-validation. LLM and agentic systems knowledge: You understand the fundamentals of LLMs (particularly the Transformer architecture) and the building blocks of agentic systems. You know how to optimize an agent's harness (prompts, tools, hooks and orchestration) to improve its reliability and performance. Builder instinct and backend comfort: You've built and shipped something used by real users, whether professionally, during an internship or as a side project. You're comfortable reading and writing backend code, working with APIs and integrating systems. AI-native curiosity: You follow developments in AI closely, experiment with new approaches on you

jobs.description: Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. jobs.title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer , you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing. What you'll be doing Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines. Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs. Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints. Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations. Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust. jobs.title: AI Builder
jobs.description: The short version Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in. As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching. We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building. What Contentoo does Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap. None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster. There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. jobs.title: GPU Engineer
jobs.description: About Kog At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents. Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act. Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs. We've developed several technologies to make this possible: Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs. KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency. Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading. Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach. Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution. Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released. Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today. These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results. We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually. This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it. Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai . Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. Et tout commence par vous.   Missions En tant qu’ AI Strategist Manager , vous construisez avec les dirigeants de nos clients une stratégie IA crédible, un modèle opératoire adapté et un programme de transformation qui génère une valeur mesurable. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions AI Strategy : vous les pilotez en autonomie, en garantissez la qualité, les délais et la rentabilité, faites grandir les consultants qui y sont staffés et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners. Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier. jobs.description: L’IA ne transforme pas une entreprise parce qu’elle est disponible, mais parce que les collaborateurs s’en emparent pour travailler autrement. Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers : “We Make AI Work”. Notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, au cœur des métiers et à grande échelle. Et tout commence par vous.   Mission En tant qu’AI Builder Manager, vous pilotez des missions et programmes AI Adoption qui font passer l’IA de l’expérimentation à la transformation des métiers. Au contact des dirigeants et des responsables métiers, vous définissez des dispositifs de montée en compétences, de construction d’agents et d’accompagnement au changement. Vous êtes le moteur de nos missions : vous en garantissez la qualité, l’impact et la rentabilité, faites grandir vos équipes et développez vos comptes aux côtés des Directeurs et Partners. Vous partez des défis des utilisateurs métiers, de leurs processus et de leurs irritants pour transformer les possibilités de l’IA en résultats tangibles. Vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous concevez des expériences d’apprentissage engageantes, challengez et construisez des solutions IA fonctionnelles (no-code, low-code, vibe coding), et mobilisez les équipes pour faire passer ces solutions du prototype à des usages durables. Vous accompagnez les organisations dans la transformation des tâches, des rôles et responsabilités, et des compétences à l’ère de l’IA. Vous articulez les initiatives de terrain (bottom-up) avec les programmes de transformation à grande échelle (top-down), en collaboration avec nos équipes AI Strategy et Engineering. jobs.title: DevOps Engineering Intern
jobs.description: About Sonio Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents. Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path. Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence. About the role We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control. Your main mission will be to: Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests: Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval. jobs.description: About Inbolt Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes. Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents. We're a team based in Paris, Detroit and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role: As our Associate Product Manager Intern, you will sit at the crossroads of our customers, our sales team and our engineers. Working alongside our Product Lead, you will make sure that what we build answers real business needs: you will gather what customers and the field are telling us, translate it into clear product priorities and specs, and give Sales and Ops the material they need to sell and deploy Inbolt with confidence. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ; c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle. Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. jobs.description: Kantor Pelayanan Pajak atau KPP adalah salah satu unit atau cabang dari Direktorat Jenderal Pajak di Indonesia. Kantor ini bertugas untuk memberikan pelayanan terkait perpajakan kepada wajib pajak yang berada di wilayahnya. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Penerimaan Pegawai Pemerintah Non Pegawai Negeri (PPNPN) KPP Pratama. Tugas utama Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama adalah mengumpulkan, mengelola, dan memberikan informasi serta panduan kepada wajib pajak mengenai peraturan perpajakan, pelaporan pajak, serta pembayaran pajak. Mereka juga melakukan pemeriksaan pajak untuk memastikan kepatuhan wajib pajak terhadap aturan perpajakan. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent

jobs.title: Graduate Transport Planner
jobs.description: At Curtins, we re an employee-owned engineering consultancy driven by a simple ambition: to create a better built environment for everyone. For over 65 years, we ve delivered practical, innovative and sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities across the UK and Ireland. From major regeneration schemes and commercial developments to education, healthcare and residential projects, our work helps shape the places where people live, learn, work and thrive. As a Graduate Transport Planner, you ll work alongside experienced planners, engineers and consultants, contributing to a wide range of projects while developing the technical and professional skills you need to build your career. Whether you re interested in transport assessments, active travel & sustainable mobility, highways or public transport, we ll give you the experience, guidance and support to find the areas that interest you most and develop your expertise in development planning. What you ll be doing You will support the planning and development process, helping clients bring projects forward from initial concept through to planning approval. Your responsibilities will include: Assisting with the preparation of Transport Assessments and Transport Statements. Supporting the production of Travel Plans and technical planning reports. Analysing traffic, transport and movement data. Assisting with junction assessments and development impact studies. Supporting planning applications for residential, commercial and mixed-use developments. Working alongside planners, civil engineers and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions. Attending client meetings, project discussions and stakeholder consultations. Taking part in wider Curtins activities including STEM outreach, charity initiatives and community projects. What kind of projects will I get to work on? You ll be involved in projects across a wide range of sectors, including: Residential developments. Urban regeneration schemes.

jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
